other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Odisha
Applicant must be a registered member of the Odisha Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board or an unmarried girl child of a member who is above 18 years old
Member must have been registered for at least one year before applying
Applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant must not be a member of any other welfare fund established under any law
Benefit is limited to a maximum of two children
If both spouses are registered beneficiaries, the assistance is extended to only one spouse
benefits_summary: Provides a marriage assistance of ₹50,000 per eligible beneficiary, with a maximum of two children covered.
